references.text: Parallel account where Caleb drives out the three sons of Anak: Sheshai, Ahiman and Talmai from Hebron
Mentions that Hebron was formerly called Kiriath-Arba, named after the greatest man among the Anakites
First mention of Ahiman, Sheshai and Talmai, descendants of Anak, when the spies came to Hebron
Joshua conquered Hebron and struck down all its inhabitants with the sword
Joshua wiped out the Anakites from the hill country, including Hebron
Caleb requests Hebron and drives out the three sons of Anak from there
Kiriath-Arba is identified as Hebron where Sarah died
